questions.question: 대화를 듣고, 남자의 마지막 말에 대한 여자의 응답으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오. [3점]
questions.context:
M: Hey, Alice. Do you remember that we’re going to the baseball game tomorrow?
W: Of course! I’m so excited. This is my first time watching a baseball game at a stadium.
M: I’m so glad that I can take you there.
W: Thanks. I think we need to bring something to eat and drink.
M: We don’t have to. There are many food stands selling various foods like pizza or fried chicken at the stadium.
W: Fantastic. Do they have instant noodles, too? If they don’t, I’d like to bring some.
M: Actually, instant noodles are not allowed in the stadium. It’s because hot water can be dangerous.
W: That makes sense. Then, are there other items we shouldn’t bring?
M: There are, but I can’t remember them all. It would be better to look them up on the stadium website.
W: ______
options: Absolutely! I won’t buy any tickets on the website.
Super! Bigger stadiums are better to enjoy games.
What a shame. We missed the game again.
Oh, no. The instant noodles are sold out.
I agree. It’s worth checking before we go.

questions.question: 대화를 듣고, 여자의 마지막 말에 대한 남자의 응답으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
questions.context:
M: Hey, Emma. What are you doing? You look busy.
W: Hi, Uncle Joe. I’m packing things for my night fishing trip tomorrow.
M: That sounds fun! You got everything you need?
W: Almost. There’s just one thing missing. I can’t find my flashlight anywhere.
M: When was the last time you used it?
W: I took it with me to the barbecue party at Grandma’s house.
M: Did you ask her about the flashlight?
W: Yes. She checked this morning and said it wasn’t there.
M: Well, I have an extra flashlight at my house. You can use it if you want.
W: That would be great! I hope it’s not any trouble for you.
M: ______
options: Definitely not. I don’t like your fish sauce.
Well, I’ll repair your house lamp as soon as possible.
No worries. I’ll bring the flashlight to you later today.
I’ll let you know when the barbecue is ready to eat.
Hmm, I have no idea where to buy a fishing net.

questions.question: 다음 상황 설명을 듣고, Chris가 Judy에게 할 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오. [3점]
questions.context:
W: Chris and Judy are father and daughter. Judy likes posting pictures of herself on her social media account. Chris often sees her pictures when he’s on social media. One day, he notices her pictures are available for anyone to see. Chris starts to worry because he remembers reading a recent news article about the dangers of AI technology. The article said AI can easily generate fake images from publicly available pictures on social media. He’s concerned that strangers might use her pictures to create fake images with AI. He wants to protect Judy from this kind of problem. So, Chris wants to tell Judy that she should block strangers’ access to her pictures on social media. In this situation, what would Chris most likely say to Judy?

Chris: ______
options: You shouldn’t allow strangers to see your pictures on social media.
Have you considered choosing images that AI has generated?
How about uploading the pictures I took onto your account?
You must cut back the time you spend on online platforms.
You don’t have to care about the comments on your posts.

questions.question: 남자가 하는 말의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.context: M: Welcome back to the Music and Life course. Songs are known to have several functions. Today, we’re learning about how songs are used at a variety of places to create group unity. First, people sing songs together in sports stadiums. Most sports teams have unique fight songs that their fans sing to express connection to the team, which works as a kind of musical uniform that unites fans. Second, the use of songs promotes group identity at schools. Students sing their school song together during important events, which helps share common values and develops a sense of unity. Next, soldiers sing songs at military bases. While they march and train, they sing their military songs together. Through this process, they build group bonds and develop into one unified force. Finally, people are brought together by work songs on farms. When people sing songs together while working on farms, they feel connected to one another and gain a sense of unity. Now, let’s listen to some example songs.
options: areas where traditional songs are disappearing
connections between music and marketing fields
use of songs to build group unity at various places
effects of selecting good locations on public events
roles of group unity in boosting individual creativity

questions.question: 다음 글의 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.context:
Dear Mr. Steve Carter,

Congratulations on the 60th graduation ceremony of Yuoralis High School. As a former student, I am extremely proud that the school has become one of the best schools in the local community. I felt honored when I received your kind invitation to deliver a speech at the ceremony. However, I am deeply sorry to say that I will not be able to give a speech because I have a very important overseas business trip scheduled during that time. I would have loved to speak to the graduating students, but I must decline your invitation to this meaningful celebration. I wish you a memorable graduation ceremony.

Sincerely,
Jane Whittmore
options: 졸업식 일정을 문의하려고
졸업식 연설 초청을 거절하려고
졸업식 자원 봉사를 지원하려고
졸업식의 미흡했던 점을 지적하려고
졸업식에서 공연할 팀을 추천하려고

questions.question: 다음 글에 드러난 Katie의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.context: On her way to school, Katie thought of the argument she had with Sarah the day before and wiped tears from her eyes. “I can’t believe I fought with my best friend,” she cried. “I just want things to go back to normal.” It seemed that nothing could help her overcome this painful moment. As she walked into her classroom, she heard a familiar voice. Sarah was calling her name. “Katie, I’m sorry for the things I said yesterday.” A big smile spread across Katie’s face. “I’m sorry, too. Let’s never fight again.” Katie and Sarah hugged each other tightly and laughed the way they always did before.
options: nervous → frustrated
sad → delighted
excited → calm
bored → happy
hopeful → disappointed

questions.question: 다음 글에서 필자가 주장하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.context: Current social changes driven by technological advancements demand a fundamental rethinking in our approach to education. In particular, lifelong learning is no longer optional; it is essential. We must recognize that the rapidly evolving socioeconomic ecology requires individuals to engage in constant upskilling and self-transformation. If we can enhance lifelong learning initiatives, we will not only promote personal growth and well-being but also sustain national productivity and global competitiveness. Furthermore, our efforts will support social integration by providing opportunities for people from various backgrounds to connect and move on together. Investing in lifelong education thus is not simply an extra expense; we must consider it a necessity for survival and success as we encounter significant changes in the years ahead. By prioritizing lifelong education, we will be able to navigate this changing world with confidence and a sense of fulfillment.
options: 변화하는 사회에 대응하기 위해 평생교육을 강화해야 한다.
융합 교육을 통해 미래 사회의 인재를 적극 육성해야 한다.
경제 교육을 강화하여 투자에 대한 바른 인식을 갖도록 해야 한다.
기술 발전을 위해 특정 분야의 전문 지식 습득을 장려해야 한다.
평생교육 기관을 설립하여 사회의 균형 발전을 도모해야 한다.

questions.context: Current social changes driven by technological advancements demand a fundamental rethinking in our approach to education. In particular, lifelong learning is no longer optional; it is essential. We must recognize that the rapidly evolving socioeconomic ecology requires individuals to engage in constant upskilling and self-transformation. If we can enhance lifelong learning initiatives, we will not only promote personal growth and well-being but also sustain national productivity and global competitiveness. Furthermore, our efforts will support social integration by providing opportunities for people from various backgrounds to connect and move on together. Investing in lifelong education thus is not simply an extra expense; we must consider it a necessity for survival and success as we encounter significant changes in the years ahead. By prioritizing lifelong education, we will be able to navigate this changing world with confidence and a sense of fulfillment.
